basic_info.description: This lovely Mission Terrace Center Patio Home has been recently updated and is ready for a new owner. On the Market for the first time in over 70 years, this fantastic home boasts Hardwood Floors, Skylights, and Art Deco Detailing in the Bathroom as well as a Center Patio that allows tons of natural light into the home. Walk through the front door and you are met with a small Foyer and a beautiful Formal Living Room that has high arching ceilings, wonderfully patterned hardwood floors, a large picture window, and a period detailed fireplace that may not have ever been used. There is also the Formal Dining Room, updated kitchen with a skylight, quartz counters, new appliances and the breakfast area as well as the Art Deco Style Bathroom with Tub, Shower Stall, new vanity and a skylight. At the back of the main level boasts the 2 bedrooms with tremendous views. The Garage Level has high ceilings plus a quarter bath and a family room at the back with access to the stairs and backyard.
